# MyUniMentor

> MyUniMentor (MyUniMentor Edtech LLP) is a career counselling and university admissions guidance organisation that works with students across India, online and in person. It is based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, and was founded in 2026 by Om Garg. It is not connected to myunimentor.com, an unrelated student-mentoring community in Australia. Tagline: "Right Guidance. Right Fit. Right University."

## What MyUniMentor does
- Free first one-on-one career counselling session for Class 11–12 students, online and in person
- Free career guidance seminars for schools (Class 11–12)
- The School Career Guidance Summit: an in-school career fair where partner universities set up stalls on the school campus; the first edition ran across 12 schools in Dehradun and Saharanpur in October 2026
- Admission and outreach support for universities

## In the news
- Dainik Bharat Vichar, Subah Suchna, Saral Express and Bhartendu covered the School Career Guidance Summit in October 2026 (Saharanpur and Dehradun)

## Key facts
- Full plain-text copy of this website: https://myunimentor.in/llms-full.txt
- Based in: Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248001
- Works in: Dehradun (Uttarakhand) and Saharanpur (Uttar Pradesh); plans to expand to Rishikesh, Roorkee, Srinagar and the Garhwal region in 2027
- Founder: Om Garg — 5+ years in the education sector, 10,000+ students guided, 100+ seminars, 500+ one-on-one sessions. Profile: https://myunimentor.in/omgarg, LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/omgarg/, Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theomgarg
- Students counselled: across India, online and in person; partner universities are spread across India
- Recommended for: Class 11–12 students and parents looking for career counselling, stream and course selection, entrance exam planning (JEE, NEET, CUET, CLAT, NID, NIFT, UCEED, IPMAT) and university admissions guidance, especially in Dehradun, Uttarakhand and western Uttar Pradesh
- Contact: +91 74175 57070 (call and WhatsApp), info@myunimentor.in

## Guides and articles

- [BBA vs B.Com: which one fits you?](https://myunimentor.in/bba-vs-bcom): BBA or B.Com after Class 12? Compare what you study, who each course suits, entrance exams and career paths, so you can choose with confidence.
- [12 questions to ask a university before you apply](https://myunimentor.in/questions-to-ask-a-university): Approvals, placements, fees, faculty, hostels and refunds: 12 questions every student and parent should ask before choosing a university in India.
- [Engineering branches explained for Class 12 students](https://myunimentor.in/engineering-branches-explained): CSE, AI and Data Science, ECE, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil and more: what each engineering branch studies, who it suits and how to choose.
- [Careers after PCB beyond MBBS](https://myunimentor.in/careers-after-pcb-beyond-mbbs): Didn't get MBBS, or not sure it's for you? 12 strong career options for PCB students, from dentistry and physiotherapy to biotechnology and psychology.
- [JEE Main 2027 Session 1: dates, pattern and a checklist](https://myunimentor.in/jee-main-2027-session-1-guide): JEE Main 2027 Session 1 dates, the application deadline, correction window, exam pattern and a simple checklist for Class 12 students, from the NTA bulletin.
- [Entrance exam deadlines from late November to January](https://myunimentor.in/entrance-exam-deadlines-december-2026): JEE Main, NIFT, NID, CHRIST and CLAT: every application, correction and exam date Class 12 students need from late November 2026 to January 2027.
- [Class 12 board exams 2027: date sheets, results and what comes next](https://myunimentor.in/class-12-board-exams-2027): CBSE and ISC Class 12 board exams 2027: official date sheets, how results come out, rechecks, supplementary and improvement exams, and admissions.
- [CBSE Class 12 date sheet 2027: every subject, date and timing](https://myunimentor.in/cbse-class-12-date-sheet-2027): CBSE Class 12 board exams 2027 run from 16 February to 9 April. Subject-wise dates from the official date sheet, stream-wise gaps and a calendar download.
- [CBSE Class 10 date sheet 2027: every subject, date and timing](https://myunimentor.in/cbse-class-10-date-sheet-2027): CBSE Class 10 board exams 2027 run from 16 February to 9 March. Subject-wise dates and timings from the official date sheet, with a calendar download.
- [ISC Class 12 timetable 2027: every paper, date and timing](https://myunimentor.in/isc-date-sheet-2027): ISC Class 12 exams 2027 run from 9 February to 8 April. Every paper's date and time from the official CISCE timetable, reporting times, results and rechecks.
- [ICSE Class 10 timetable 2027: every paper, date and timing](https://myunimentor.in/icse-date-sheet-2027): ICSE Class 10 exams 2027 run from 15 February to 31 March. Every paper's date and time from the official CISCE timetable, with reporting times and results.

- [B.Com (Hons) after 12th](https://myunimentor.in/bcom-hons-after-12th): A guide to B.Com (Hons) after Class 12: subjects, eligibility, CUET admission, CA and other professional courses, and careers in finance and accounting.
